# Northwind Roastery Brand Guide (excerpt)

- Voice: friendly, knowledgeable, never clinical.
- Always name the farm/origin (no "mystery coffee").
- Prices use USD with the $ symbol.
- Never claim health benefits. Past tense of "roast" is "roasted", not "roasted-up".
- Hashtags: use #NorthwindRoastery, no more than two per social post.
